notion.outboundDescLong: New Focuspilot projects create a Notion page; tasks on that project add rows to a task table on the page.{workspacePart}
notion.inboundDescLong: Map a shared database below to import Notion rows as Focuspilot projects (manual sync).
notion.mapDatabaseHint: Map a Notion database (e.g. Tasks Tracker) to create and update Focuspilot projects.
notion.disconnectDescLong: Focuspilot will lose access to your Notion workspace. You can reconnect anytime.
notion.connectDescLong: Authorize Focuspilot in Notion and share the databases you want to use.
notion.cardDescWorkspace: Workspace: {workspace}. Use settings to browse databases and sync projects.
notion.cardDescBrowse: Use settings to browse databases and sync projects.
notion.cardDescDisconnected: Connect your Notion workspace to browse databases and sync projects.
notion.mappingDialogDesc: Each row in the database becomes a Focuspilot project. Re-sync updates names and status.
notion.browseDialogDesc: Only databases you shared when connecting Notion appear here. Copy an ID for Zapier or open in Notion.
notion.databasesLoadFailed: Could not load databases from Notion.
notion.reconnectHint: Reconnect Notion on this environment (localhost uses its own token).
notion.noDatabasesFound: No databases found. In Notion, open a database → ••• → Connect to → your Focuspilot integration.

googleCalendar.disconnectDesc: This disconnects Google (Gmail Inbox uses the same OAuth connection).
googleCalendar.connectDesc: Uses Google OAuth (same as Gmail). Enable Calendar API in Google Cloud Console.
googleCalendar.gmailMissingCalendarWarning: Gmail is connected but Calendar access is missing. Reconnect and allow Calendar permissions.

xero.disconnectDesc: Focuspilot will stop syncing with Xero. You can reconnect anytime.
